description: Records its two inputs and, when the recording ends, replaces the whole contents of the Memory with it; it runs while touching a group of modules with a Memory or MemoryCV at the left-hand end

params.text: Latches; it records while lit, and clicking it dark hands the recording to the Memory as its entire new contents, changing the length of the Memory to match
Sets how many CLOCK intervals a clocked recording lasts, 0.001 to 32, and a fractional value stops part way through the last interval
Pressing it arms a recording to start at the next CLOCK trigger; pressing it again while armed disarms it

inputs.text: A high gate records, and when it falls low the recording becomes the entire new contents of the Memory
The left channel taken into the recording
The right channel taken into the recording
Once armed, the first trigger starts the recording, and further triggers count off the intervals until COUNT of them have passed
A trigger arms a recording, which starts at the next CLOCK trigger and lasts COUNT of them; an ARM and a CLOCK arriving together start it at once

notes: it records nothing until a Memory or MemoryCV is the left-most module of the touching group it is in; the small light near the top edge is lit while it is attached
no more than 60 seconds can be recorded, and a longer recording leaves the Memory holding the last 60 seconds
ending a recording on two of these at roughly the same moment in one group gives unpredictable results
the module has no menu items of its own
